RootCommand.Description: vdf-cli — Video Duplicate Finder command-line interface
ScanAndCompare.Description: Enumerate files, build hashes, and find duplicates in one step.
Scan.Description: Enumerate files and build hashes (scan phase only).
Compare.Description: Compare existing hashes from database and find duplicates (compare phase only).
Mark.Description: Mark duplicate files for deletion using a strategy.
Option.Output: Write results to file instead of stdout
Option.DryRun: Show what would be deleted without deleting
Option.Delete: Move marked files to system trash
Error.NoIncludePath: Error: at least one --include path is required.
Error.InvalidFormat: Error: invalid output format. Use: json, text, or csv
